changes.evidence: Captain America: Civil War: the Ayo/Natasha standoff ('Move, or you will be moved') happens at the Joint Counter Terrorist Centre in Berlin, as T'Challa leaves after learning the Winter Soldier escaped the building, not in Vienna.

now.title: Captain America: The First Avenger

now.on_a_card_about_b: The agent who drugs Zola and his guards to rescue Erskine.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The HYDRA scientist Peggy drugs to rescue Erskine.

proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An SSR agent whom Zola's interrogation leads to the Red Skull's last base.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: HYDRA's leading scientist, whose interrogation leads Peggy's SSR to the Red Skull's last base.

changes.evidence: Peggy drugging Zola and the castle guards to free Erskine is from the tie-in comic Captain America: First Vengeance (CAFV3), not the film. In The First Avenger, Zola is captured on the train and his intel locates the final HYDRA base; the card lines do not match the stage text.

split.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#6
split.text: Sharon helps Sam stop the Flag Smashers in New York and gets the full pardon he promised her, while she is secretly the Power Broker.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Gets the pardon Sam wins her after New York. Secretly the Power Broker.

changes.evidence: Sharon first appears in ep 3 'Power Broker' (Madripoor; Wilson promises to get her pardoned). The pardon and the reveal that she is the Power Broker are in ep 6 'One World, One People'. The stage starts at the show's beginning and names the ep 6 reveal.

owner_calls.question: Stage 1 (Ant-Man and the Wasp) says Scott takes a deal 'from Ross'. Ross does not appear in Ant-Man and the Wasp, where the house arrest is overseen by FBI agent Jimmy Woo; the deal is first mentioned in Avengers: Infinity War ('he and Scott took a deal'). Keep it as is, move the stage to Avengers: Infinity War, or reword it as a deal with the government?
options: move stage title to Avengers: Infinity War
reword: Scott is under house arrest after taking a deal for his part in the Accords fight (no Ross)
owner_calls.evidence: The Scott Lang fandom page says Lang 'made a deal with the FBI' / 'with the government'; the Thaddeus Ross page says Scott and Clint 'took deals from Ross'. The Ant-Man and the Wasp plot names only Jimmy Woo.
